Examples:

budget.header_protection: All native token positions overlapping the exact shared system-header character span, including any boundary-crossing token; excludes demonstrations except boundary overlap. Compute per case before inference, record indices/count/byte cost, and charge within the same fixed total budget
budget.infeasible_policy: Stop the entire preparation before model inference; do not truncate the protected header, increase budgets, or drop cases

adapted_snapkv.gqa_reduction: mean over query heads sharing a KV head
adapted_snapkv.label: Existing independent Qwen2 adaptation, not original fair SnapKV or a new algorithm

random.policy: Deterministic per source-key/layer/KV-head random scores on original positions; same score stream for pinned/unpinned variants, with common anchors and required header charged before filling remaining slots; no gold or model outcome access

stages: First3 new cases: Full native/nohook/hook/100%-gather checks, at most12 extra outputs; no compressed outputs yet
Generate all10 new Full main outputs, freeze baseline IDs and scores
If Full gate passes, first3 new cases compressed native/custom reference checks for two representative methods, at most12 further extra outputs
If engineering passes, generate all original10 cases for all4 compressed conditions, including Full-wrong cases; no adaptive method selection

full_support_gate.on_failure: Stop before any compressed reference/main outputs; preserve all10 Full and mark other40 not_run_full_support_gate. Do not alter prompts/models/budgets/IDs
full_support_gate.meaning: Descriptive minimum support and clean format baseline only, not a statistical power calculation; same50% exact-support fraction as development gate, not an AccessDenied exception

primary_endpoint: For all10 fixed queries, count Full-format-valid to compressed-format-invalid outputs separately for each method; complete raw-response label inventory membership
secondary_endpoints: Full-to-compressed exact C2C/C2W/W2C/W2W with all10 and actual Full-correct denominator
pin-versus-unpinned format and exact transitions for each method
all-case results plus descriptive flagged-case listing; never drop flagged cases
scorer: Same prior whole response.strip() label-format and exact-gold scoring. Remove only terminal EOS token; do not first-line-filter primary scores or hide other special tokens. Official firstline compatibility remains secondary
reporting_constraints: No method winner or significance claim from n10, no stable family ranking, no combination with development as an independently confirmed sample. Zero format failures or improvements are valid outcomes; do not run more seeds/budgets to induce failures
overlap: Unused test questions on same source/length subset, not independent training examples or a power-guaranteed confirmation set
engineering_gates: all sources/cases/header/tokenizer SHA match and new IDs never in previous experimental main outputs
all10 native IDs, source question/context/gold bytes and fixed budget assertions pass
first3 Full native/nohook/hook and every-policy100% gather agree
Full gate frozen before compressed reference outputs
first3 compressed physical-cache/original-RoPE trajectories and HF reference/custom IDs agree
all4 methods every case/layer/head exact equal bytes, anchors/header charged, actual score/maps saved; snapshot enabled only after checks
on_runner_failure: Preserve bounded partial outputs and manifests, mark remaining cells not_run_engineering_gate; do not silently fallback or retry model outcomes
after_single_recheck: Stop this calibration round and synthesize development+holdout separately. Do not automatically expand cases, methods, budgets or models
runner_warning: Existing development runner is hardcoded to32 and baseline19. Requires a new bounded10-case stage-aware adapter; do not merely disable its cohort/budget assertions
old_gates: No changes to stopped native IFEval or failed AccessDenied gates
